raw_segments.text: The tall girls went out and returned presently, each bearing a tray, with portions of something
I knew not what, arranged thereon, and a pitcher of water and mug in the middle of each tray.
Those who liked took a draft of the water, the mug being common to all.
When it came to my turn I drank for I was thirsty, but did not touch the food, excitement
and fatigue rendering me incapable of eating.
I now saw, however, that it was a thin oat and cake shared into fragments.
